name: TrainBoulder
_intent: Boulder breaking from a left front stance, seen in profile: a long slow coil (hips and shoulders turned away, weight back, the striking palm chambered at the hip, the other arm out as a sight), a 3-frame snap with the hips leading and the weight driven forward, the palm heel ON the rock for 3 frames while the body shudders, a slow recoil; right palm-heel, then left palm thrust.
_reference: shotei-uchi on a boulder; Hit at frames 45 and 105 (2.000 s apart)
